Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just go by the claim number if that's okay.
Q: That works for our file. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was in the right lane on a main road in Katy, Texas, heading toward the freeway. Traffic had slowed down ahead
of me, so I was stopped at a light.
Q: Did you come to a complete stop before the impact?
A: Yes, I was completely stopped, foot on the brake. Then I felt a hard jolt from behind.
Q: What kind of vehicle were you driving?
A: A midsize sedan. The back end took most of the damage, and the airbags did not deploy.
Q: Did you speak with the other driver?
A: Briefly. They apologized and said they looked down at their phone for a second. They gave me their insurance
card.
Q: Were there any witnesses?
A: I don't think so. A few cars were going by, but nobody stopped that I noticed.
Q: Tell me about your injuries.
A: My right knee hit the dashboard. It swelled up within a couple of hours, and I've had trouble bending it and putting
weight on it since. I went to an urgent care clinic that same evening and they took X-rays and told me to follow up with
a specialist.
Q: Have you seen that specialist yet?
A: I have an appointment next week. I've been using crutches around the house in the meantime.
Q: Did you have any knee problems before this collision?
A: No, nothing that stopped me from working or exercising.
Q: Is there anything else you think I should know?
A: Just that I'm still having trouble driving because of the pain. I'd like to get this resolved as soon as possible.
Q: Thank you. We'll be in touch with next steps.
</page>

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
